verdict.rationale: Greenhouse has a first-party webhooks documentation page that lists subscribable event types such as application created/deleted, candidate hired and candidate merged, so its own product offers event webhooks. The pack shows only the event list, not how endpoints are registered, the payload format, or delivery guarantees. Missing for 10: documented endpoint registration flow, payload schema, signature/security verification, retry/delivery semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
